headline: US Embassy Accuses Canada of Seeking to Influence Midterm Elections Over Tariffs
summary: The US Embassy in Ottawa published a factsheet accusing Canadian federal and provincial ministers of seeking to influence the upcoming US midterm elections through rhetoric on retaliatory tariffs and political lobbying.
why: Cross-border trade between the US and Canada exceeds $700 billion annually, making trade disputes and political friction economically consequential.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Heightened diplomatic friction with the US raises the threat of bilateral trade sanctions or tariffs.
